headline: Paramount developing a Cyberpunk 2077 film
summary: Paramount Pictures is developing a live-action Cyberpunk 2077 film, with CD Projekt Red producing. No premiere date has been set.

claims.statement: Paramount Pictures is making a live-action Cyberpunk 2077 film.

sources.quote: Paramount is making a Cyberpunk 2077 film
CD Projekt Red's popular sci-fi video game franchise is being adapted into a live-action film by Paramount Pictures

claims.statement: Paramount will develop the film while CD Projekt Red produces it.

sources.quote: Paramount Pictures will develop the film and CD Projekt Red will produce.
